correctness.rationale: Proof establishes every claimed parameter and boundary. Any slide changes exactly one membership per side, giving the lower bound. Maximal opposite-direction direct pairings can be scheduled inside the feasible level interval; residual wrong/needed vertices lie on a single side and admit exactly two-step relays. Every construction remains feasible and uses precisely the lower-bound number of moves. The diameter upper bound uses selected/omitted capacities and the sharp witnesses exhaust three cases; the connected maximum layer has a three-step extremizer. The standalone verifier checks 617027 ordered BFS distances in 68 small cases and 2175 type-extrema cases; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The input paper explicitly leaves exact complete-bipartite layer distances at upper bounds. The exact pairwise shortest-path theorem for all connected layers proves a nontrivial isometric property under visibility constraints, and the sharp diameter formula has three genuinely active regimes with exact extremizers and a top-layer exceptional boundary. This is mathematically substantive beyond correctness, a narrow instance, or routine parameter evaluation.
